summary: Use a JavaScript runtime deep-strict comparison for Node util.isDeepStrictEqual object graphs and built-in types.

semantics.comparison: Node deep strict equality across primitives, prototypes, enumerable properties and supported built-in collection/value types
semantics.numeric_edges: must preserve Node strict treatment of NaN and signed zero
semantics.options: modern Node options such as prototype-skipping behavior must be honored when supplied

caveats: C# Equals/SequenceEqual do not implement Node's graph, prototype, Map/Set, typed-array, Error, and cycle rules.

tests.name: edge signed zero
tests.expected_behavior: returns false under Node deep strict equality
